pages.text: All Akaishi trinkets share the same energy handling:$(li)each effect drains its own internal energy buffer first$(li)when the buffer is depleted, the trinket draws power from $(l:akaishi:portable_cell)Portable Cells$(/l) in the inventory$(li)one cell keeps the whole set operational away from the base$(br2)They are divided into three roles, each with its own entry: $(l:akaishi:curios_income)Fortune Trinkets$(/l) drop crystals, $(l:akaishi:curios_defense)Defense Trinkets$(/l) reduce damage, and $(l:akaishi:curios_survival)Sustain Trinkets$(/l) provide food and cure debuffs.

$(bold)Slot map (Curios):$(reset)$(li)rings → ring$(li)bracelets → hands$(li)pendants → necklace$(li)charms → charm$(li)chest trinkets → body$(li)bangles → bracelet$(li)waist trinkets → belt$(br2)An item placed in the wrong slot cannot be equipped. Available slots should be checked before equipping.

$(bold)Akaishi extension slots:$(reset) four additional slots are unlocked on the body as Akaishi progression advances. The slot names are displayed as unreadable text, so they are distinguished by the icon colour at the bottom of the slot: red, gold, green and aqua correspond to slots one through four.$(br2)Thresholds are counted in completed nodes on the Akaishi Path advancement tree: slot one requires 1 node, slot two requires 2, slot three requires 3 and slot four requires 4.$(br2)Each threshold can be adjusted under the Akaishi curio extension slots config category; disabling Extension slots require progress unlocks all four immediately.

$(bold)Purpose of these four slots:$(reset) they are used by the Forbidden trinkets. Each forbidden trinket corresponds to one slot colour:$(li)red → Touch of a Thousand Hands$(li)gold → Quickening of the Cub$(li)green → The Mother's Gaze$(li)aqua → Endless Gestation$(br2)None of the four is craftable at a table. They are produced only by the Mother Altar ritual, which requires a Tier 3 altar, 8 outer offerings and a large amount of life energy. The complete ritual, offering list and wearing cost are in the Forbidden Ritual entry in Life's Secrets.$(br2)Wearing one has strong effects and a correspondingly high cost.

The three group entries are $(l:akaishi:curios_income)Fortune$(/l), $(l:akaishi:curios_defense)Defense$(/l) and $(l:akaishi:curios_survival)Sustain$(/l); they are powered by the $(l:akaishi:portable_cell)Portable Cell$(/l).
